points.point: What the unsupported media format error means
points.sentence: Blotato did not recognize the file's container brand, and a name ending in .mp4 does not prove the format.

points.point: Why a file named .mp4 still gets this error
points.sentence: Blotato did not recognize the file's container brand, and a name ending in .mp4 does not prove the format.
Export the source as MP4 with H.264 video and AAC audio. Renaming the extension does not change the container.

verdict.reason: This entry covers the exact error text. It explains that the .mp4 filename doesn't prove the container, and it gives the re-export fix.
